name: Guardian Tiger
source:
The Guardian Tiger in Manzu’s temple. Brought to Taipei by Liao. 

As Liao gains the ability to talk with spirits, Lin Hu wants to bring him home and have him tend to the family business. However, Liao believes being an Oracle is old fashioned, putting the tiger in a difficult position. 

Having been living with Liao in Taipei for a great deal of time, he reads Liao’s books while staying at home. Leading him to learn a great deal about modern life and often shares his findings with Liao. 

Likes to eat fried chicken.

[From [url=https://www.nekojishi.tw/en-char.html]official site[/url]]
